skill_name: Explain why the Euro became one of the world's major currencies.
workflow: The Euro became one of the world's major currencies mainly due to the European Union (EU), which was established in 1993. The EU provided a unified economic and monetary policy that allowed for a free flow of capital and services, which promoted trade and investment opportunities throughout Europe. The adoption of the Euro as a common currency also provided a stable and predictable currency exchange rate, making it easier for businesses to trade internationally.
